title: 表观遗传学
text: 今天的太阳将光合作用的能量传递给万物，而生物体对外部刺激的响应则远比可见的光化学反应复杂。表观遗传学研究的是在不改变脱氧核糖核酸序列前提下，基因表达发生可遗传变化的机制。这种现象主要通过DNA甲基化以及组蛋白修饰来实现。甲基基团的添加能够有效抑制特定转录因子的结合，从而导致基因沉默。与此同时，乙酰化过程则倾向于使染色质结构变得松散，进而增强蛋白合成的效率。环境因素在这一过程中扮演着决定性角色。饮食结构、压力水平以及污染物暴露均会诱发化学标记的重组。这意味着个体在生命周期内所经历的外部环境，能够直接塑造其生理表型。这种调控机制赋予了生物体极强的可塑性，使其能迅速适应多变的生态位。例如，营养匮乏的母体可能会通过表观遗传标记，影响后代代谢系统的发育。这种跨代传递的特性打破了传统遗传学的决定论观点。它证明了基因组并非静态的蓝图，而是一部可编辑的动态剧本。神经科学领域的研究表明，社会隔离会导致大脑前额叶皮层相关基因的甲基化水平升高。这种分子层面的改变与认知功能下降具有显著相关性。此外，药物干预能够部分逆转这些有害的修饰，为精神疾病治疗提供了新路径。精准医疗正致力于开发针对特定表观标记的靶向药物。通过操纵酶的活性，科学家试图重新激活被抑制的抑癌基因。这种前沿技术有望在癌症治疗中取得突破性进展。理解环境与基因的交互作用，对于公共卫生政策的制定至关重要。我们必须意识到，当前的生存条件将深刻影响未来世代的健康基准。生物多样性的维持亦依赖于这种灵活的调控能力。综上所述，生命是个体遗传潜能与外部环境持续博弈的产物。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what two mechanisms mainly realize epigenetic change?
options: DNA methylation and histone modification
Gene deletion and chromosome duplication
Mitochondrial mutation and RNA splicing
Protein folding and enzyme degradation

questions.prompt: What effect does the addition of a methyl group have, according to the text?
options: It inhibits transcription-factor binding and leads to gene silencing
It permanently deletes the affected gene from the genome
It always activates gene expression
It has no measurable effect on gene expression

questions.prompt: What example does the text give of a transgenerational epigenetic effect?
options: A malnourished mother's epigenetic marks may affect her offspring's metabolic development
Only fathers can pass epigenetic marks to offspring
Epigenetic marks are always erased completely at conception
Epigenetic effects only appear after three generations

questions.prompt: According to the text, what is found regarding social isolation and the brain?
options: It raises methylation levels of prefrontal-cortex genes, correlating with cognitive decline
It has no measurable effect on brain gene expression
It only affects genes related to physical, not cognitive, function
It permanently and irreversibly damages the genome sequence

questions.prompt: How does the text describe the genome, in contrast to a static blueprint?
options: As an editable, dynamic script
As an unchangeable fixed program
As a random and meaningless sequence
As a perfect predictor of an individual's future

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.
